hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־נֹ֔חַ וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־הַֽחַיָּה֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָ֑ה וַיַּעֲבֵ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים ר֨וּחַ֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּשֹׁ֖כּוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃

en: God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all the livestock that were with him in the ark. God caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.
es: Dios se acordó de Noé, de todos los animales silvestres y de todo el ganado que estaban con él en el arca. Dios hizo pasar un viento sobre la tierra, y las aguas se calmaron.

es: Al cabo de los siete días, las aguas del diluvio estaban sobre la tierra.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v10

hebrew: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֤וֹת שָׁנָה֙ לְחַיֵּי־נֹ֔חַ בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָֽה־עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה נִבְקְעוּ֙ כָּֽל־מַעְיְנֹת֙ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וַאֲרֻבֹּ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נִפְתָּֽחוּ׃
ko: 노아가 살아온 지 육백 년째 되는 해, 둘째 달 열이렛날, 바로 그날 큰 깊음의 모든 샘이 터지고 하늘의 창들이 열렸다.
en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that very day all the springs of the great deep burst open, and the windows of the heavens were opened.
es: En el año seiscientos de la vida de Noé, en el mes segundo, el día diecisiete del mes, ese mismo día se rompieron todas las fuentes del gran abismo y se abrieron las ventanas de los cielos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v11

hebrew: וַֽיְהִ֥י הַגֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה׃
ko: 비가 사십 일과 사십 밤 동안 땅 위에 내렸다.
en: The rain was upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
es: La lluvia cayó sobre la tierra durante cuarenta días y cuarenta noches.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v12

hebrew: בְּעֶ֨צֶם הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ בָּ֣א נֹ֔חַ וְשֵׁם־וְחָ֥ם וָיֶ֖פֶת בְּנֵי־נֹ֑חַ וְאֵ֣שֶׁת נֹ֗חַ וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת נְשֵֽׁי־בָנָ֛יו אִתָּ֖ם אֶל־הַתֵּבָֽה׃
ko: 바로 그날 노아와 그의 아들 셈과 함과 야벳, 노아의 아내와 아들들의 세 아내가 그들과 함께 방주로 들어갔다.
en: On that very day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, Noah’s sons, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark.
es: Ese mismo día entraron en el arca Noé, Sem, Cam y Jafet, hijos de Noé, la mujer de Noé y las tres mujeres de sus hijos con ellos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v13

hebrew: הֵ֜מָּה וְכָל־הַֽחַיָּ֣ה לְמִינָ֗הּ וְכָל־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְכָל־הָרֶ֛מֶשׂ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְכָל־הָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֔הוּ כֹּ֖ל צִפּ֥וֹר כָּל־כָּנָֽף׃
ko: 그들과 온갖 들짐승이 각기 그 종류대로, 온갖 가축이 각기 그 종류대로, 땅 위를 기어 다니는 온갖 것이 각기 그 종류대로, 온갖 날짐승이 각기 그 종류대로, 곧 모든 새와 날개 달린 모든 것이 들어갔다.
en: They, and every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth according to its kind, and every flying creature according to its kind—every bird, every winged thing—entered.
es: Entraron ellos, todo animal silvestre según su clase, todo ganado según su clase, todo lo que se arrastra por la tierra según su clase y todo ser volador según su clase: toda ave, todo ser alado.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v14

hebrew: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־נֹ֖חַ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֑ה שְׁנַ֤יִם שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ מִכָּל־הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ ר֥וּחַ חַיִּֽים׃
ko: 생명의 숨이 있는 모든 육체 가운데서 둘씩 노아에게 와서 방주로 들어갔다.
en: They came to Noah, into the ark, two by two from all flesh in which was the breath of life.
es: Vinieron a Noé, al arca, de dos en dos, de toda carne en la que había aliento de vida.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v15

hebrew: וְהַבָּאִ֗ים זָכָ֨ר וּנְקֵבָ֤ה מִכָּל־בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֔אוּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּֽעֲדֽוֹ׃
ko: 들어간 것들은 모든 육체 가운데 수컷과 암컷으로, 하나님이 노아에게 명령하신 대로 들어갔다. 여호와가 노아를 안에 두고 닫으셨다.
en: Those entering, male and female of all flesh, entered as God had commanded him; and YHWH shut him in.
es: Los que entraban, macho y hembra de toda carne, entraron como Dios le había mandado; y YHWH lo encerró.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v16

hebrew: וַֽיְהִ֧י הַמַּבּ֛וּל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים י֖וֹם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־הַתֵּבָ֔ה וַתָּ֖רָם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ko: 홍수가 사십 일 동안 땅 위에 있었다. 물이 불어나 방주를 들어 올렸고, 방주는 땅 위로 떠올랐다.
en: The flood was on the earth for forty days. The waters increased and lifted the ark, and it rose above the earth.
es: El diluvio estuvo sobre la tierra cuarenta días. Las aguas aumentaron y levantaron el arca, y esta se elevó sobre la tierra.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v17

hebrew: וַיִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַמַּ֛יִם וַיִּרְבּ֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֖ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃
ko: 물의 세력이 커지고 땅 위에서 크게 불어났으며, 방주는 물 위를 움직여 갔다.
en: The waters grew strong and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark moved over the surface of the waters.
es: Las aguas cobraron fuerza y aumentaron mucho sobre la tierra, y el arca se movía sobre la superficie de las aguas.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v18

hebrew: וְהַמַּ֗יִם גָּֽבְר֛וּ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹ֖ד עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיְכֻסּ֗וּ כָּל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ הַגְּבֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
ko: 물이 땅 위에서 매우 크게 세력을 더하여, 온 하늘 아래의 높은 산들이 모두 덮였다.
en: The waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth, and all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.
es: Las aguas prevalecieron sobremanera sobre la tierra, y quedaron cubiertas todas las montañas altas que había bajo todo el cielo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v19

hebrew: חֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ מִלְמַ֔עְלָה גָּבְר֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיְכֻסּ֖וּ הֶהָרִֽים׃
ko: 물이 위로 십오 암마만큼 불어났고, 산들이 덮였다.
en: The waters rose fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.
es: Las aguas subieron quince codos hacia arriba, y los montes quedaron cubiertos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v20

hebrew: וַיִּגְוַ֞ע כָּל־בָּשָׂ֣ר ׀ הָרֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ בָּע֤וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבַ֣חַיָּ֔ה וּבְכָל־הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל הָאָדָֽם׃
ko: 땅 위에서 움직이던 모든 육체, 곧 새와 가축과 들짐승과 땅 위에 우글거리던 모든 기는 것과 모든 사람의 숨이 끊어졌다.
en: All flesh that moved on the earth perished: the birds, livestock, wild animals, every swarming thing that swarmed on the earth, and all humankind.
es: Pereció toda carne que se movía sobre la tierra: las aves, el ganado, las bestias, todo lo que pululaba sobre la tierra y toda la humanidad.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v21

hebrew: כֹּ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁמַת־ר֨וּחַ חַיִּ֜ים בְּאַפָּ֗יו מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֶּחָֽרָבָ֖ה מֵֽתוּ׃
ko: 마른 땅에 있던 모든 것 가운데 콧구멍에 생명의 숨이 있는 것은 모두 죽었다.
en: Everything on dry ground that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
es: Murió todo lo que estaba en tierra seca y tenía aliento de vida en sus narices.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v22

hebrew: וַיִּ֜מַח אֶֽת־כָּל־הַיְק֣וּם ׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ׀ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה מֵאָדָ֤ם עַד־בְּהֵמָה֙ עַד־רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ וְעַד־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמָּח֖וּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִשָּׁ֧אֶר אַךְ־נֹ֛חַ וַֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָֽה׃
ko: 지면 위의 모든 생물을 쓸어버렸고, 사람부터 가축과 기는 것과 하늘의 새까지 땅에서 쓸려 없어졌다. 오직 노아와 그와 함께 방주 안에 있던 이들만 남았다.
en: He wiped out every living thing on the surface of the ground, from humans to livestock, creeping things, and the birds of the heavens. They were wiped from the earth; only Noah and those with him in the ark remained.
es: Borró todo ser viviente sobre la superficie del suelo, desde los seres humanos hasta el ganado, los animales que se arrastran y las aves de los cielos. Fueron borrados de la tierra; solo quedaron Noé y los que estaban con él en el arca.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v23

hebrew: וַיִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
ko: 물이 백오십 일 동안 땅 위에서 세력을 떨쳤다.
en: The waters prevailed over the earth for one hundred and fifty days.
es: Las aguas prevalecieron sobre la tierra durante ciento cincuenta días.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 7:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-7/#v24

hebrew: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽאָדָ֔ם לָרֹ֖ב עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃
ko: 사람들이 땅 위에서 늘어나기 시작하고 그들에게 딸들이 태어났을 때에,
en: When humankind began to multiply on the face of the ground and daughters were born to them,
es: Cuando la humanidad comenzó a multiplicarse sobre la faz de la tierra y les nacieron hijas,
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v1

hebrew: וַיִּרְא֤וּ בְנֵי־הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֥י טֹבֹ֖ת הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ׃
ko: 하나님의 아들들은 사람의 딸들이 아름다운 것을 보고, 자기들이 고른 모든 이들 가운데서 아내들을 맞아들였다.
en: The sons of God saw that the daughters of humankind were beautiful, and they took wives for themselves from all whom they chose.
es: Los hijos de Dios vieron que las hijas de la humanidad eran hermosas y tomaron para sí esposas de entre todas las que escogieron.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v2

hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא־יָד֨וֹן רוּחִ֤י בָֽאָדָם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ם בְּשַׁגַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר וְהָי֣וּ יָמָ֔יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
ko: 여호와가 말했다. “나의 영이 사람 안에 영원히 머물지는 않을 것이다. 그도 육체이기 때문이다. 그의 날들은 백이십 년이 될 것이다.”
en: YHWH said, “My spirit will not remain in humankind forever, because they too are flesh. Their days will be one hundred twenty years.”
es: YHWH dijo: «Mi espíritu no permanecerá en la humanidad para siempre, porque también es carne. Sus días serán ciento veinte años».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v3

hebrew: הַנְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָאָרֶץ֮ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֒ וְגַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֜אוּ בְּנֵ֤י הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְיָלְד֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַגִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַשֵּֽׁם׃
ko: 그 무렵, 그리고 그 뒤에도, 땅에는 네피림이 있었다. 하나님의 아들들이 사람의 딸들과 동침하고 딸들이 그들에게 자녀를 낳아 주곤 하던 때였다. 그들은 옛날의 용사들, 이름난 사람들이었다.
en: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God would go in to the daughters of humankind and they bore children to them. They were the mighty men of old, men of renown.
es: Los nefilim estaban en la tierra en aquellos días, y también después, cuando los hijos de Dios se unían a las hijas de la humanidad y ellas les daban hijos. Esos fueron los poderosos de antaño, hombres de renombre.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v4

hebrew: וַיַּ֣רְא יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־יֵ֨צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
ko: 여호와는 땅에서 사람의 악이 크고, 그 마음의 생각이 빚어 내는 모든 것이 언제나 악할 뿐임을 보았다.
en: YHWH saw that the wickedness of humankind was great on the earth, and that everything the thoughts of their heart devised was only evil all the time.
es: YHWH vio que la maldad de la humanidad era grande en la tierra y que todo lo que forjaban los pensamientos de su corazón era solo maldad todo el tiempo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v5

hebrew: וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל־לִבּֽוֹ׃
ko: 여호와는 땅에 사람을 만든 것을 후회했고, 마음 깊이 슬퍼했다.
en: YHWH regretted that he had made humankind on the earth, and he was grieved in his heart.
es: YHWH lamentó haber hecho a la humanidad en la tierra y se afligió en su corazón.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v6

hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת־הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֨אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד־בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד־רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְעַד־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם׃
ko: 여호와께서 말씀하셨다. “내가 창조한 사람을 땅 위에서 지워 버리겠다. 사람부터 짐승과 기어 다니는 것과 하늘의 새에 이르기까지 그리하겠다. 내가 그들을 만든 것을 후회하기 때문이다.”
en: YHWH said, “I will wipe from the face of the ground the human beings I created—from humans to beasts, to creeping things, and to the birds of the heavens—for I regret that I made them.”
es: YHWH dijo: «Borraré de la faz del suelo a la humanidad que creé, desde los seres humanos hasta las bestias, los seres que se arrastran y las aves de los cielos, porque lamento haberlos hecho».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v7

hebrew: וְנֹ֕חַ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
ko: 그러나 노아는 여호와께 은혜를 입었다.
en: But Noah found favor in the eyes of YHWH.
es: Pero Noé halló gracia a los ojos de YHWH.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v8

hebrew: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים הָיָ֖ה בְּדֹֽרֹתָ֑יו אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־נֹֽחַ׃
ko: 이것은 노아의 내력이다. 노아는 의로운 사람이었고, 자기 세대들 가운데 흠이 없었다. 노아는 하나님과 함께 걸었다.
en: This is the account of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among his generations. Noah walked with God.
es: Esta es la historia de Noé. Noé era un hombre justo, íntegro en sus generaciones. Noé caminaba con Dios.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v9

hebrew: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד נֹ֖חַ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים אֶת־שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־חָ֥ם וְאֶת־יָֽפֶת׃
ko: 노아는 세 아들, 셈과 함과 야벳을 낳았다.
en: Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
es: Noé engendró tres hijos: Sem, Cam y Jafet.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v10

hebrew: וַתִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ חָמָֽס׃
ko: 땅은 하나님 앞에서 부패했고, 땅에는 폭력이 가득했다.
en: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
es: La tierra estaba corrompida ante Dios, y la tierra estaba llena de violencia.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v11

hebrew: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי־הִשְׁחִ֧ית כָּל־בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת־דַּרְכּ֖וֹ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ko: 하나님이 땅을 보시니, 보라, 땅이 부패해 있었다. 모든 육체가 땅 위에서 자기 길을 부패시켰기 때문이다.
en: God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.
es: Dios vio la tierra, y he aquí que estaba corrompida, porque toda carne había corrompido su camino sobre la tierra.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v12

hebrew: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְנֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כָּל־בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי־מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ חָמָ֖ס מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהִנְנִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖ם אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ko: 하나님이 노아에게 말씀하셨다. “모든 육체의 끝이 내 앞에 이르렀다. 그들 때문에 땅에 폭력이 가득 찼으니, 보라, 내가 그들을 땅과 함께 멸하겠다.
en: God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. Behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.
es: Dios dijo a Noé: «El fin de toda carne ha llegado ante mí, porque la tierra está llena de violencia por causa de ellos. Mira, voy a destruirlos junto con la tierra.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v13

hebrew: עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ תֵּבַ֣ת עֲצֵי־גֹ֔פֶר קִנִּ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת־הַתֵּבָ֑ה וְכָֽפַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛הּ מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ בַּכֹּֽפֶר׃
ko: 너는 고페르 나무로 방주를 만들어라. 방주에 칸들을 만들고, 그 안팎을 역청으로 발라라.
en: Make yourself an ark of gopher wood. Make compartments in the ark, and coat it inside and out with pitch.
es: Hazte un arca de madera de gófer. Haz compartimentos en el arca y recúbrela por dentro y por fuera con brea.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v14

hebrew: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֹתָ֑הּ שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
ko: 너는 방주를 이렇게 만들어라. 길이는 삼백 규빗, 너비는 오십 규빗, 높이는 삼십 규빗으로 하여라.
en: This is how you shall make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
es: Así la harás: el largo del arca será de trescientos codos, su ancho de cincuenta codos y su altura de treinta codos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v15

hebrew: צֹ֣הַר ׀ תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה לַתֵּבָ֗ה וְאֶל־אַמָּה֙ תְּכַלֶ֣נָּה מִלְמַ֔עְלָה וּפֶ֥תַח הַתֵּבָ֖ה בְּצִדָּ֣הּ תָּשִׂ֑ים תַּחְתִּיִּ֛ם שְׁנִיִּ֥ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶֽׂהָ׃
ko: 방주에 채광구를 만들되, 위로부터 한 규빗으로 그것을 마무리하여라. 방주의 문은 옆면에 내고, 아래층과 둘째 층과 셋째 층을 만들어라.
en: Make a light opening for the ark, and finish it to a cubit at the top. Set the door of the ark in its side; make it with lower, second, and third decks.
es: Haz una abertura de luz para el arca, y termínala a un codo desde arriba. Pon la puerta del arca en su costado; hazla con un piso inferior, un segundo y un tercero.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v16

hebrew: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶת־הַמַּבּ֥וּל מַ֨יִם֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת כָּל־בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ חַיִּ֔ים מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָ֖רֶץ יִגְוָֽע׃
ko: 보라, 내가 하늘 아래 생명의 숨이 있는 모든 육체를 멸하려고 땅 위에 물의 홍수를 일으키겠다. 땅에 있는 모든 것이 숨을 거둘 것이다.
en: Behold, I myself am bringing a flood of water upon the earth to destroy all flesh under heaven that has the breath of life in it. Everything on the earth shall perish.
es: Mira, yo mismo voy a traer un diluvio de aguas sobre la tierra para destruir toda carne bajo el cielo que tenga aliento de vida. Todo lo que hay en la tierra perecerá.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v17

hebrew: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֔ה אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֛יךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֥ וּנְשֵֽׁי־בָנֶ֖יךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
ko: 그러나 나는 너와 내 언약을 세우겠다. 너는 네 아들들과 네 아내와 네 며느리들과 함께 방주로 들어가라.
en: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall enter the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
es: Pero estableceré mi pacto contigo. Entrarás en el arca, tú y tus hijos, tu mujer y las mujeres de tus hijos contigo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v18

hebrew: וּמִכָּל־הָ֠חַי מִֽכָּל־בָּשָׂ֞ר שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל תָּבִ֥יא אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑ךְ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
ko: 살아 있는 모든 것, 모든 육체 가운데서 각각 둘씩 방주로 데려와 너와 함께 살아남게 하여라. 그것들은 수컷과 암컷이어야 한다.
en: From every living thing, from all flesh, you shall bring two of each into the ark to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.
es: De todo ser viviente, de toda carne, llevarás dos de cada uno al arca para conservarlos con vida contigo; serán macho y hembra.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v19

hebrew: מֵהָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֗הוּ וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְהַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃
ko: 새는 그 종류대로, 짐승은 그 종류대로, 땅에서 기는 모든 것은 그 종류대로, 각각 둘씩 네게 와서 살아남게 될 것이다.
en: From the birds according to their kinds, from the animals according to their kinds, and from every creeping thing of the ground according to its kind, two of each shall come to you to be kept alive.
es: De las aves según su clase, de los animales según su clase y de todo lo que se arrastra por el suelo según su clase, dos de cada uno vendrán a ti para ser conservados con vida.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v20

hebrew: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֗ מִכָּל־מַֽאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֛ וְלָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
ko: 너는 먹을 수 있는 온갖 먹을거리를 가져다가 네게 모아 두어라. 그것이 너와 그것들의 먹을 것이 될 것이다.”
en: As for you, take some of every kind of food that is eaten and gather it to yourself; it shall be food for you and for them.”
es: Y tú, toma de todo alimento que se come y reúnelo junto a ti; servirá de alimento para ti y para ellos.»
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v21

hebrew: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃
ko: 노아는 그렇게 하였다. 하나님께서 그에게 명령하신 모든 것대로, 그는 그대로 하였다.
en: Noah did this; according to all that God commanded him, so he did.
es: Noé lo hizo así; conforme a todo lo que Dios le había mandado, así lo hizo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 6:1–22 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-6/#v22

hebrew: זֶ֣ה סֵ֔פֶר תּוֹלְדֹ֖ת אָדָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם בְּרֹ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אָדָ֔ם בִּדְמ֥וּת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
ko: 이것은 아담 계보의 기록이다. 하나님이 사람을 창조하실 때, 하나님의 모습을 따라 그를 만드셨다.
en: This is the record of Adam’s descendants. When God created humankind, he made them in the likeness of God.
es: Este es el registro de la descendencia de Adán. Cuando Dios creó al ser humano, lo hizo a semejanza de Dios.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 5:1–32 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-5/#v1

hebrew: זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בְּרָאָ֑ם וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָ֗ם וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמָם֙ אָדָ֔ם בְּי֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָֽם׃
ko: 그들을 남자와 여자로 창조하시고, 그들을 창조하신 날에 복을 주시며 그들의 이름을 “사람”이라 부르셨다.
en: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them Humankind when they were created.
es: Varón y mujer los creó, los bendijo y los llamó «Ser humano» cuando fueron creados.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 5:1–32 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-5/#v2

hebrew: וַֽיְחִ֣י אָדָ֗ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּמְאַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בִּדְמוּת֖וֹ כְּצַלְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵֽׁת׃
ko: 아담은 백삼십 년을 살고 자기 모습을 따라, 자기 형상대로 아들을 낳아 그의 이름을 셋이라 불렀다.
en: Adam lived one hundred thirty years and fathered a son in his likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.
es: Adán vivió ciento treinta años y engendró un hijo a su semejanza, conforme a su imagen, y lo llamó Set.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 5:1–32 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-5/#v3

hebrew: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־אָדָ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שֵׁ֔ת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
ko: 아담은 셋을 낳은 뒤 팔백 년을 살며 아들들과 딸들을 낳았다.
en: After fathering Seth, Adam lived eight hundred years and fathered sons and daughters.

es: Ella volvió a dar a luz a su hermano Abel. Abel llegó a ser pastor de rebaños, y Caín era labrador de la tierra.

hebrew: וַֽיְהִ֖י מִקֵּ֣ץ יָמִ֑ים וַיָּבֵ֨א קַ֜יִן מִפְּרִ֧י הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

hebrew: וְהֶ֨בֶל הֵבִ֥יא גַם־ה֛וּא מִבְּכֹר֥וֹת צֹאנ֖וֹ וּמֵֽחֶלְבֵהֶ֑ן וַיִּ֣שַׁע יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־הֶ֖בֶל וְאֶל־מִנְחָתֽוֹ׃

en: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and their fat portions. YHWH looked with favor on Abel and his offering.
es: Abel también trajo de los primogénitos de su rebaño y de sus porciones de grasa. YHWH miró con favor a Abel y a su ofrenda.

hebrew: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־קָ֑יִן לָ֚מָּה חָ֣רָה לָ֔ךְ וְלָ֖מָּה נָפְל֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
ko: 여호와가 가인에게 말씀하셨다. “네가 왜 화를 내느냐? 네 낯빛은 왜 어두워졌느냐?

citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 4:1–26 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-4/#v6

hebrew: הֲל֤וֹא אִם־תֵּיטִיב֙ שְׂאֵ֔ת וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תֵיטִ֔יב לַפֶּ֖תַח חַטָּ֣את רֹבֵ֑ץ וְאֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָת֔וֹ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּמְשָׁל־בּֽוֹ׃

hebrew: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל־הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑יו וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּהְיוֹתָ֣ם בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַיָּ֥קָם קַ֛יִן אֶל־הֶ֥בֶל אָחִ֖יו וַיַּהַרְגֵֽהוּ׃

citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 4:1–26 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-4/#v8

hebrew: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־קַ֔יִן אֵ֖י הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵ֥ר אָחִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי׃

hebrew: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ ק֚וֹל דְּמֵ֣י אָחִ֔יךָ צֹעֲקִ֥ים אֵלַ֖י מִן־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃

hebrew: הֵן֩ גֵּרַ֨שְׁתָּ אֹתִ֜י הַיּ֗וֹם מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה וּמִפָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶסָּתֵ֑ר וְהָיִ֜יתִי נָ֤ע וָנָד֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה כָל־מֹצְאִ֖י יַֽהַרְגֵֽנִי׃

hebrew: וַיֵּ֥צֵא קַ֖יִן מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־נ֖וֹד קִדְמַת־עֵֽדֶן׃

hebrew: וַיֵּ֤דַע קַ֨יִן֙ אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־חֲנ֑וֹךְ וַֽיְהִי֙ בֹּ֣נֶה עִ֔יר וַיִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הָעִ֔יר כְּשֵׁ֖ם בְּנ֥וֹ חֲנֽוֹךְ׃

hebrew: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֥וֹ לֶ֖מֶךְ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאַחַת֙ עָדָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית צִלָּֽה׃

hebrew: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑ית וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה הַנָּחָ֥שׁ הִשִּׁיאַ֖נִי וָאֹכֵֽל׃

en: YHWH God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
es: YHWH Dios dijo a la mujer: «¿Qué es esto que has hecho?». La mujer dijo: «La serpiente me engañó, y comí».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v13

hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ אֶֽל־הַנָּחָשׁ֮ כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּאת֒ אָר֤וּר אַתָּה֙ מִכָּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וּמִכֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה עַל־גְּחֹנְךָ֣ תֵלֵ֔ךְ וְעָפָ֥ר תֹּאכַ֖ל כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
ko: 여호와 하나님이 뱀에게 말씀하셨다. “네가 이 일을 했으므로, 너는 모든 집짐승과 모든 들짐승보다 더 저주받았다. 너는 배로 다니며 네 평생 흙을 먹을 것이다.
en: YHWH God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and all wild animals. On your belly you will go, and dust you will eat all the days of your life.
es: YHWH Dios dijo a la serpiente: «Por haber hecho esto, maldita eres más que todo el ganado y todos los animales del campo. Sobre tu vientre andarás y polvo comerás todos los días de tu vida.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v14

hebrew: וְאֵיבָ֣ה ׀ אָשִׁ֗ית בֵּֽינְךָ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ וּבֵ֣ין זַרְעָ֑הּ ה֚וּא יְשׁוּפְךָ֣ רֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תְּשׁוּפֶ֥נּוּ עָקֵֽב׃
ko: 내가 너와 여자 사이에, 네 후손과 여자의 후손 사이에 적의를 두겠다. 그 후손은 네 머리를 치고, 너는 그 후손의 발꿈치를 칠 것이다.”
en: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. That offspring will strike you on the head, and you will strike that offspring on the heel.”
es: Pondré enemistad entre ti y la mujer, y entre tu descendencia y su descendencia. Esa descendencia te golpeará en la cabeza, y tú la golpearás en el talón».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v15

hebrew: אֶֽל־הָאִשָּׁ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הַרְבָּ֤ה אַרְבֶּה֙ עִצְּבוֹנֵ֣ךְ וְהֵֽרֹנֵ֔ךְ בְּעֶ֖צֶב תֵּֽלְדִ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְאֶל־אִישֵׁךְ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָתֵ֔ךְ וְה֖וּא יִמְשָׁל־בָּֽךְ׃
ko: 여자에게는 말씀하셨다. “내가 네 임신의 고통을 크게 늘리겠다. 너는 고통 속에서 자녀를 낳을 것이다. 네 갈망은 네 남편을 향하고, 그는 너를 다스릴 것이다.”
en: To the woman he said, “I will greatly increase your pain in pregnancy. In pain you will bear children. Your desire will be toward your husband, and he will rule over you.”
es: A la mujer le dijo: «Aumentaré mucho tu dolor en el embarazo. Con dolor darás a luz hijos. Tu deseo se dirigirá a tu marido, y él gobernará sobre ti».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v16

hebrew: וּלְאָדָ֣ם אָמַ֗ר כִּֽי־שָׁמַעְתָּ֮ לְק֣וֹל אִשְׁתֶּךָ֒ וַתֹּ֨אכַל֙ מִן־הָעֵ֔ץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּיתִ֨יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֲרוּרָ֤ה הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּֽעֲבוּרֶ֔ךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
ko: 아담에게는 말씀하셨다. “네가 아내의 말을 듣고, 내가 먹지 말라고 명령한 그 나무에서 먹었으므로, 너 때문에 땅이 저주받았다. 너는 평생 고된 수고로 그 땅에서 먹을 것을 얻을 것이다.
en: To Adam he said, “Because you listened to your wife and ate from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You shall not eat from it,’ cursed is the ground because of you. Through painful toil you will eat from it all the days of your life.
es: A Adán le dijo: «Porque escuchaste a tu mujer y comiste del árbol del que te mandé: “No comerás de él”, maldita es la tierra por tu causa. Con penoso trabajo comerás de ella todos los días de tu vida.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v17

hebrew: וְק֥וֹץ וְדַרְדַּ֖ר תַּצְמִ֣יחַֽ לָ֑ךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ אֶת־עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
ko: 땅은 네게 가시와 엉겅퀴를 돋아나게 할 것이고, 너는 들의 식물을 먹을 것이다.
en: It will bring forth thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
es: Te producirá espinos y cardos, y comerás las plantas del campo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v18

hebrew: בְּזֵעַ֤ת אַפֶּ֨יךָ֙ תֹּ֣אכַל לֶ֔חֶם עַ֤ד שֽׁוּבְךָ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה לֻקָּ֑חְתָּ כִּֽי־עָפָ֣ר אַ֔תָּה וְאֶל־עָפָ֖ר תָּשֽׁוּב׃
ko: 너는 땅으로 돌아갈 때까지 얼굴에 땀을 흘리며 빵을 먹을 것이다. 네가 그 땅에서 취해졌기 때문이다. 너는 티끌이니 티끌로 돌아갈 것이다.”
en: By the sweat of your face you will eat bread until you return to the ground, for from it you were taken. For you are dust, and to dust you will return.”
es: Con el sudor de tu rostro comerás pan hasta que vuelvas a la tierra, pues de ella fuiste tomado. Porque eres polvo, y al polvo volverás».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v19

hebrew: וַיִּקְרָ֧א הָֽאָדָ֛ם שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ חַוָּ֑ה כִּ֛י הִ֥וא הָֽיְתָ֖ה אֵ֥ם כָּל־חָֽי׃
ko: 그 사람이 자기 아내의 이름을 하와라고 불렀다. 그 여자가 모든 살아 있는 이의 어머니였기 때문이다.
en: The man called his wife’s name Eve, because she was the mother of all the living.
es: El hombre llamó Eva a su mujer, porque ella era la madre de todos los vivientes.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v20

hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְאָדָ֧ם וּלְאִשְׁתּ֛וֹ כָּתְנ֥וֹת ע֖וֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵֽׁם׃
ko: 여호와 하나님이 아담과 그의 아내에게 가죽옷을 만들어 입혀 주셨다.
en: YHWH God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.
es: YHWH Dios hizo túnicas de piel para Adán y su mujer, y los vistió.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v21

hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים הֵ֤ן הָֽאָדָם֙ הָיָה֙ כְּאַחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לָדַ֖עַת ט֣וֹב וָרָ֑ע וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ פֶּן־יִשְׁלַ֣ח יָד֗וֹ וְלָקַח֙ גַּ֚ם מֵעֵ֣ץ הַֽחַיִּ֔ים וְאָכַ֖ל וָחַ֥י לְעֹלָֽם׃
ko: 여호와 하나님이 말씀하셨다. “보라, 그 사람이 선과 악을 아는 데서 우리 가운데 하나처럼 되었다. 이제 그가 손을 뻗어 생명나무에서도 따 먹고 영원히 살지 않도록…”
en: YHWH God said, “Look, the human has become like one of us in knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
es: YHWH Dios dijo: «Mira, el ser humano ha llegado a ser como uno de nosotros en conocer el bien y el mal. Y ahora, no sea que extienda la mano y tome también del árbol de la vida, coma y viva para siempre…».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v22

hebrew: וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֛הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִגַּן־עֵ֑דֶן לַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֻקַּ֖ח מִשָּֽׁם׃
ko: 그래서 여호와 하나님이 그를 에덴동산에서 내보내어, 그가 취해진 땅을 일구게 하셨다.
en: So YHWH God sent him out from the garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
es: Entonces YHWH Dios lo envió fuera del jardín de Edén para trabajar la tierra de la que había sido tomado.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v23

hebrew: וַיְגָ֖רֶשׁ אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּשְׁכֵּן֩ מִקֶּ֨דֶם לְגַן־עֵ֜דֶן אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֗ים וְאֵ֨ת לַ֤הַט הַחֶ֨רֶב֙ הַמִּתְהַפֶּ֔כֶת לִשְׁמֹ֕ר אֶת־דֶּ֖רֶךְ עֵ֥ץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
ko: 그분은 그 사람을 쫓아내시고, 생명나무로 가는 길을 지키도록 에덴동산 동쪽에 케루빔들과 이리저리 도는 칼의 불꽃을 두셨다.
en: He drove out the human and stationed the cherubim and the flame of the turning sword east of the garden of Eden to guard the way to the tree of life.
es: Expulsó al ser humano y puso al este del jardín de Edén a los querubines y la llama de la espada que giraba, para guardar el camino al árbol de la vida.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 3:1–24 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-3/#v24

hebrew: וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָֽם׃
ko: 하늘과 땅과 그 모든 무리가 완성되었다.
en: Thus the heavens and the earth and all their host were completed.
es: Así quedaron terminados los cielos y la tierra, y todo cuanto hay en ellos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v1

hebrew: וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
ko: 하나님께서는 일곱째 날에 하시던 일을 마치셨고, 일곱째 날에는 하시던 모든 일에서 손을 떼셨다.
en: On the seventh day God finished the work he had done, and on the seventh day he ceased from all the work he had done.
es: En el séptimo día Dios terminó la obra que había hecho, y en el séptimo día cesó de toda la obra que había hecho.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v2

hebrew: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
ko: 하나님께서는 일곱째 날에 복을 주시고 그날을 거룩하게 하셨다. 그날에 하나님께서 창조하여 이루신 모든 일에서 손을 떼셨기 때문이다.
en: God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he ceased from all the work God had created and made.
es: Dios bendijo el séptimo día y lo santificó, porque en él cesó de toda la obra que Dios había creado y hecho.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v3

hebrew: אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִבָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
ko: 이것은 하늘과 땅이 창조될 때의 내력이다. 여호와 하나님께서 땅과 하늘을 만드시던 때에,
en: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created. When Yahweh God made earth and heavens,
es: Este es el relato de los cielos y la tierra cuando fueron creados. Cuando Yahvé Dios hizo tierra y cielos,
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v4

hebrew: וְכֹ֣ל ׀ שִׂ֣יחַ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ וְכָל־עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
ko: 들의 어떤 관목도 아직 땅에 없었고, 들의 어떤 풀도 아직 싹트지 않았다. 여호와 하나님께서 땅에 비를 내리지 않으셨고, 땅을 일굴 사람도 없었기 때문이다.
en: No shrub of the field was yet on the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprouted, because Yahweh God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no human to work the ground.
es: Aún no había en la tierra ningún arbusto del campo, ni había brotado ninguna planta del campo, porque Yahvé Dios no había hecho llover sobre la tierra y no había ser humano que cultivara el suelo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v5

hebrew: וְאֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת־כָּל־פְּנֵֽי־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
ko: 그러나 물줄기가 땅에서 솟아올라 땅의 온 표면을 적시곤 했다.
en: But a flow of water would rise from the earth and water the whole surface of the ground.
es: Pero una corriente de agua subía de la tierra y regaba toda la superficie del suelo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v6

hebrew: וַיִּיצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서는 땅의 흙먼지로 그 사람을 빚으시고, 그의 콧구멍에 생명의 숨을 불어넣으셨다. 그러자 그 사람이 살아 있는 존재가 되었다.
en: Yahweh God formed the human from dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and the human became a living being.
es: Yahvé Dios formó al ser humano del polvo del suelo y sopló en sus narices aliento de vida; y el ser humano se convirtió en un ser viviente.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v7

hebrew: וַיִּטַּ֞ע יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים גַּן־בְעֵ֖דֶן מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם שָׁ֔ם אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서는 동쪽 에덴에 동산을 심으시고, 자신이 빚으신 그 사람을 거기에 두셨다.
en: Yahweh God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, and placed there the human whom he had formed.
es: Yahvé Dios plantó un jardín en Edén, al este, y puso allí al ser humano que había formado.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v8

hebrew: וַיַּצְמַ֞ח יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כָּל־עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서는 보기에 아름답고 먹기에 좋은 모든 나무를 땅에서 자라게 하셨으며, 동산 한가운데의 생명나무와 선과 악을 아는 나무도 자라게 하셨다.
en: Yahweh God caused every tree pleasing to the sight and good for food to grow from the ground, including the tree of life in the midst of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
es: Yahvé Dios hizo brotar del suelo todo árbol agradable a la vista y bueno para comer, incluido el árbol de la vida en medio del jardín y el árbol del conocimiento del bien y del mal.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v9

hebrew: וְנָהָרּ֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים׃
ko: 에덴에서 강 하나가 흘러나와 동산에 물을 대고 있었다. 거기에서 갈라져 네 줄기가 되었다.
en: A river flowed out of Eden to water the garden; from there it divided into four branches.
es: Un río salía de Edén para regar el jardín; desde allí se dividía en cuatro brazos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v10

hebrew: שֵׁ֥ם הָֽאֶחָ֖ד פִּישׁ֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסֹּבֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃
ko: 첫째 강의 이름은 비손이다. 이 강은 금이 있는 하윌라 땅 전체를 두루 흐른다.
en: The name of the first is Pishon; it flows around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
es: El nombre del primero es Pisón; rodea toda la tierra de Javilá, donde hay oro.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v11

hebrew: וּֽזֲהַ֛ב הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא ט֑וֹב שָׁ֥ם הַבְּדֹ֖לַח וְאֶ֥בֶן הַשֹּֽׁהַם׃
ko: 그 땅의 금은 좋다. 거기에는 브돌라흐와 쇼함 돌도 있다.
en: The gold of that land is good; bdellium and shoham stone are there.
es: El oro de esa tierra es bueno; allí hay bedelio y piedra de shóham.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v12

hebrew: וְשֵֽׁם־הַנָּהָ֥ר הַשֵּׁנִ֖י גִּיח֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסּוֹבֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ כּֽוּשׁ׃
ko: 둘째 강의 이름은 기혼이다. 이 강은 구스 땅 전체를 두루 흐른다.
en: The name of the second river is Gihon; it flows around the whole land of Cush.
es: El nombre del segundo río es Guijón; rodea toda la tierra de Cus.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v13

hebrew: וְשֵׁ֨ם הַנָּהָ֤ר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ חִדֶּ֔קֶל ה֥וּא הַֽהֹלֵ֖ךְ קִדְמַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר וְהַנָּהָ֥ר הָֽרְבִיעִ֖י ה֥וּא פְרָֽת׃
ko: 셋째 강의 이름은 힛데겔이다. 이 강은 아슈르 동쪽으로 흐른다. 넷째 강은 프라트이다.
en: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it flows east of Asshur. The fourth river is Perath.
es: El nombre del tercer río es Hidequel; corre al este de Asur. El cuarto río es Perat.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v14

hebrew: וַיִּקַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּנִּחֵ֣הוּ בְגַן־עֵ֔דֶן לְעָבְדָ֖הּ וּלְשָׁמְרָֽהּ׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서는 그 사람을 데려다가 에덴 동산에 두시어, 그곳을 일구고 지키게 하셨다.
en: Yahweh God took the human and placed him in the garden of Eden to work it and keep it.
es: Yahvé Dios tomó al ser humano y lo puso en el jardín de Edén para trabajarlo y cuidarlo.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v15

hebrew: וַיְצַו֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־הָֽאָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִכֹּ֥ל עֵֽץ־הַגָּ֖ן אָכֹ֥ל תֹּאכֵֽל׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서 그 사람에게 명령하여 말씀하셨다. “동산의 모든 나무에서 너는 마음껏 먹어도 된다.
en: Yahweh God commanded the human, saying, “You may freely eat from every tree of the garden;
es: Yahvé Dios ordenó al ser humano: «Puedes comer libremente de todos los árboles del jardín;
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v16

hebrew: וּמֵעֵ֗ץ הַדַּ֨עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם אֲכָלְךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
ko: 그러나 선과 악을 아는 나무에서는 먹지 마라. 네가 그것에서 먹는 날에는 반드시 죽을 것이다.”
en: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for on the day you eat from it you will surely die.”
es: pero no comerás del árbol del conocimiento del bien y del mal, porque el día que comas de él, morirás sin falta».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v17

hebrew: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ־לּ֥וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서 말씀하셨다. “그 사람이 홀로 있는 것은 좋지 않다. 내가 그에게 상응하는 돕는 이를 만들어 주겠다.”
en: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the human to be alone. I will make for him a helper corresponding to him.”
es: Yahvé Dios dijo: «No es bueno que el ser humano esté solo. Le haré una ayuda que le corresponda».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v18

hebrew: וַיִּצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִן־הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה כָּל־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לִרְא֖וֹת מַה־יִּקְרָא־ל֑וֹ וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקְרָא־ל֧וֹ הָֽאָדָ֛ם נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ׃
ko: 여호와 하나님께서는 땅에서 들의 모든 짐승과 하늘의 모든 새를 빚으시고, 그 사람이 그것들을 무엇이라 부르는지 보시려고 그에게 데려오셨다. 그 사람이 살아 있는 각 존재를 무엇이라 부르든 그것이 그 이름이 되었다.
en: Yahweh God formed from the ground every animal of the field and every bird of the heavens, and brought them to the human to see what he would call them. Whatever the human called each living creature, that was its name.
es: Yahvé Dios formó de la tierra todos los animales del campo y todas las aves de los cielos, y los llevó ante el ser humano para ver cómo los llamaría. El nombre que el ser humano diera a cada ser viviente, ese fue su nombre.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v19

hebrew: וַיִּקְרָ֨א הָֽאָדָ֜ם שֵׁמ֗וֹת לְכָל־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּלְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּלְאָדָ֕ם לֹֽא־מָצָ֥א עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
ko: 그 사람은 모든 가축과 하늘의 새와 들의 모든 짐승에게 이름을 붙였다. 그러나 그 사람에게 상응하는 돕는 이는 발견되지 않았다.
en: The human gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the heavens and to every animal of the field. But for the human no helper corresponding to him was found.
es: El ser humano puso nombre a todo el ganado, a las aves de los cielos y a todos los animales del campo. Pero para el ser humano no se halló una ayuda que le correspondiera.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v20

hebrew: וַיַּפֵּל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים ׀ תַּרְדֵּמָ֛ה עַל־הָאָדָ֖ם וַיִּישָׁ֑ן וַיִּקַּ֗ח אַחַת֙ מִצַּלְעֹתָ֔יו וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר בָּשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתֶּֽנָּה׃
ko: 여호와 하나님이 그 사람에게 깊은 잠이 들게 하시니 그가 잠들었다. 그분은 그의 갈빗대 하나를 취하시고 그 자리를 살로 닫으셨다.
en: YHWH God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the human, and he slept. He took one of his ribs and closed up its place with flesh.
es: YHWH Dios hizo caer un sueño profundo sobre el ser humano, y este se durmió. Tomó una de sus costillas y cerró su lugar con carne.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v21

hebrew: וַיִּבֶן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים ׀ אֶֽת־הַצֵּלָ֛ע אֲשֶׁר־לָקַ֥ח מִן־הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיְבִאֶ֖הָ אֶל־הָֽאָדָֽם׃
ko: 여호와 하나님이 그 사람에게서 취하신 갈빗대로 여자를 지으시고, 그 여자를 그 사람에게 데려오셨다.
en: YHWH God built the rib he had taken from the human into a woman and brought her to the human.
es: YHWH Dios construyó una mujer con la costilla que había tomado del ser humano y la llevó ante él.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v22

hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ הָֽאָדָם֒ זֹ֣את הַפַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽעֲצָמַ֔י וּבָשָׂ֖ר מִבְּשָׂרִ֑י לְזֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵאִ֖ישׁ לֻֽקֳחָה־זֹּֽאת׃
ko: 그 사람이 말했다. “이번에야말로 내 뼈에서 나온 뼈, 내 살에서 나온 살이구나. 이를 여자라 부를 것이다. 남자에게서 취해졌기 때문이다.”
en: The human said, “This time, bone from my bones and flesh from my flesh! This one shall be called woman, for from man this one was taken.”
es: El ser humano dijo: «¡Esta vez, hueso de mis huesos y carne de mi carne! Esta será llamada mujer, porque del varón fue tomada».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v23

hebrew: עַל־כֵּן֙ יַֽעֲזָב־אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־אָבִ֖יו וְאֶת־אִמּ֑וֹ וְדָבַ֣ק בְּאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהָי֖וּ לְבָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
ko: 그러므로 남자는 자기 아버지와 어머니를 떠나 아내와 굳게 결합하고, 그들은 한 몸이 된다.
en: Therefore a man leaves his father and his mother and holds fast to his wife, and they become one flesh.
es: Por eso el varón deja a su padre y a su madre, se une firmemente a su mujer, y llegan a ser una sola carne.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v24

hebrew: וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵיהֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים הָֽאָדָ֖ם וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֖א יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ׃
ko: 그 사람과 그의 아내는 둘 다 벌거벗고 있었으나 부끄러워하지 않았다.
en: The human and his wife were both naked, but they were not ashamed.
es: El ser humano y su mujer estaban ambos desnudos, pero no sentían vergüenza.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 2:1–25 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-2/#v25

hebrew: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ko: 태초에 하나님께서 하늘과 땅을 창조하셨다.
en: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
es: Al comienzo, Dios creó los cielos y la tierra.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v1

hebrew: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֨הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃
ko: 땅은 형체 없이 비어 있었고, 어둠이 깊음의 표면 위에 있었으며, 하나님의 바람이 물의 표면 위를 맴돌고 있었다.
en: The earth was unformed and empty, darkness lay over the surface of the deep, and a wind of God hovered over the surface of the waters.

ko: 하나님께서 말씀하셨다. “땅은 제 종류대로 살아 있는 생물을, 가축과 기어 다니는 것과 땅의 들짐승을 제 종류대로 내어라.” 그대로 되었다.
en: God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, creeping things and wild animals of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.
es: Dios dijo: «Que la tierra produzca seres vivos según sus clases: ganado, seres que se arrastran y animales silvestres de la tierra según sus clases». Y así fue.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v24

hebrew: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֩ אֶת־חַיַּ֨ת הָאָ֜רֶץ לְמִינָ֗הּ וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
ko: 하나님께서 땅의 들짐승을 제 종류대로, 가축을 제 종류대로, 땅 위에서 기어 다니는 모든 것을 제 종류대로 만드셨다. 하나님께서 보시니 좋았다.
en: God made the wild animals of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that creeps on the ground according to its kind. God saw that it was good.
es: Dios hizo los animales silvestres de la tierra según sus clases, el ganado según sus clases y todo lo que se arrastra por el suelo según su clase. Dios vio que era bueno.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v25

hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֛ם בְּצַלְמֵ֖נוּ כִּדְמוּתֵ֑נוּ וְיִרְדּוּ֩ בִדְגַ֨ת הַיָּ֜ם וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבְכָל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבְכָל־הָרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ko: 하나님께서 말씀하셨다. “우리의 형상대로, 우리를 닮게 사람을 만들자. 그들이 바다의 물고기와 하늘의 날짐승과 가축과 온 땅과 땅 위를 기어 다니는 모든 것을 다스리게 하자.”
en: God said, “Let us make humankind in our image, according to our likeness, and let them rule over the fish of the sea, the winged creatures of the sky, the livestock, all the earth and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
es: Dios dijo: «Hagamos a la humanidad a nuestra imagen, conforme a nuestra semejanza; que gobiernen sobre los peces del mar, los seres alados del cielo, el ganado, toda la tierra y todo ser que se arrastra por ella».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v26

hebrew: וַיִּבְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אֶת־הָֽאָדָם֙ בְּצַלְמ֔וֹ בְּצֶ֥לֶם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּרָ֣א אֹת֑וֹ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בָּרָ֥א אֹתָֽם׃
ko: 하나님께서 사람을 그분의 형상대로 창조하셨다. 하나님의 형상대로 그를 창조하셨다. 남성과 여성으로 그들을 창조하셨다.
en: God created humankind in his image; in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.
es: Dios creó al ser humano a su imagen; a imagen de Dios lo creó; varón y mujer los creó.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v27

hebrew: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָם֮ אֱלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֛וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁ֑הָ וּרְד֞וּ בִּדְגַ֤ת הַיָּם֙ וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּבְכָל־חַיָּ֖ה הָֽרֹמֶ֥שֶׂת עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
ko: 하나님께서 그들에게 복을 주시고 말씀하셨다. “열매를 맺고 번성하여 땅을 채우고 정복하여라. 바다의 물고기와 하늘의 날짐승과 땅 위를 움직이는 모든 생물을 다스려라.”
en: God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish of the sea, the winged creatures of the sky and every living thing that moves on the earth.”
es: Dios los bendijo y les dijo: «Sean fecundos y multiplíquense; llenen la tierra y sométanla. Gobiernen sobre los peces del mar, los seres alados del cielo y todo ser vivo que se mueve en la tierra».
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v28

hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־כָּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב ׀ זֹרֵ֣עַ זֶ֗רַע אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־כָּל־הָעֵ֛ץ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ פְרִי־עֵ֖ץ זֹרֵ֣עַ זָ֑רַע לָכֶ֥ם יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לְאָכְלָֽה׃
ko: 하나님께서 말씀하셨다. “보아라, 내가 온 땅 위의 씨 맺는 모든 풀과, 씨 맺는 나무 열매가 있는 모든 나무를 너희에게 주었다. 이것들이 너희의 먹을거리가 될 것이다.
en: God said, “Look, I have given you every plant bearing seed on the face of all the earth and every tree whose fruit bears seed. They shall be yours for food.
es: Dios dijo: «Miren, les he dado toda planta que da semilla sobre la superficie de toda la tierra y todo árbol cuyo fruto da semilla. Serán su alimento.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v29

hebrew: וּֽלְכָל־חַיַּ֣ת הָ֠אָרֶץ וּלְכָל־ע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וּלְכֹ֣ל ׀ רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה אֶת־כָּל־יֶ֥רֶק עֵ֖שֶׂב לְאָכְלָ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
ko: 땅의 모든 들짐승과 하늘의 모든 날짐승과 땅 위를 기어 다니는 모든 것, 곧 그 안에 생명이 있는 것들에게는 모든 푸른 풀을 먹을거리로 주었다.” 그대로 되었다.
en: And to every wild animal of the earth, every winged creature of the sky and everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
es: Y a todo animal silvestre de la tierra, a todo ser alado del cielo y a todo lo que se arrastra por la tierra y tiene vida, les he dado toda planta verde como alimento». Y así fue.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v30

hebrew: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ט֖וֹב מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃
ko: 하나님께서 만드신 모든 것을 보시니, 보아라, 매우 좋았다. 저녁이 되고 아침이 되었다. 여섯째 날이었다.
en: God saw everything he had made, and look: it was very good. Evening came and morning came: the sixth day.
es: Dios vio todo cuanto había hecho, y miren: era muy bueno. Llegó la tarde y llegó la mañana: el sexto día.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Genesis 1:1–31 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/genesis-1/#v31

hebrew: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃
ko: 복되다, 그 사람은. 악인들의 조언을 따라 걷지 않고, 죄인들의 길에 서지 않으며, 비웃는 자들의 자리에 앉지 않는 사람.
en: Happy is the person who does not walk by the counsel of the wicked, stand in the way of sinners, or sit in the seat of scoffers.
es: Dichosa la persona que no camina según el consejo de los malvados, ni se detiene en el camino de los pecadores, ni se sienta en el asiento de los burladores.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v1

hebrew: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
ko: 오히려 그의 기쁨은 여호와의 가르침에 있고, 그분의 가르침을 밤낮으로 읊조린다.
en: Rather, his delight is in YHWH’s instruction, and he recites it day and night.
es: Más bien, su deleite está en la instrucción de YHWH, y la recita día y noche.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v2

hebrew: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃
ko: 그는 물길들 곁에 심긴 나무와 같아서, 제때 열매를 내고 잎이 시들지 않는다. 그가 하는 모든 일이 잘 이루어진다.
en: He is like a tree planted beside channels of water, yielding its fruit in its season, its leaf not withering. Everything he does prospers.
es: Es como un árbol plantado junto a canales de agua, que da su fruto a su tiempo y cuya hoja no se marchita. Todo lo que hace prospera.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v3

hebrew: לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃
ko: 악인들은 그렇지 않다. 오히려 바람이 몰아내는 겨와 같다.
en: Not so the wicked! Rather, they are like chaff that the wind drives away.
es: ¡No así los malvados! Son como el tamo que el viento se lleva.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v4

hebrew: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃
ko: 그러므로 악인들은 심판에서 서지 못하며, 죄인들은 의인들의 회중 가운데 서지 못한다.
en: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
es: Por eso los malvados no se mantendrán en pie en el juicio, ni los pecadores en la asamblea de los justos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v5

hebrew: כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
ko: 여호와께서 의인들의 길을 아시기 때문이다. 그러나 악인들의 길은 멸망한다.
en: For YHWH knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked perishes.
es: Porque YHWH conoce el camino de los justos, pero el camino de los malvados perece.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v6

hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ׃
ko: 여호와께서 네게 복을 주시고 너를 지키시기를.
en: May YHWH bless you and guard you.
es: Que YHWH te bendiga y te guarde.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Numbers 6:24–26 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/numbers-6-24-26/#v24

hebrew: יָאֵ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה ׀ פָּנָ֛יו אֵלֶ֖יךָ וִֽיחֻנֶּֽךָּ׃
ko: 여호와께서 그분의 얼굴을 네게 비추시고 네게 은혜를 베푸시기를.
en: May YHWH make his face shine toward you and be gracious to you.
es: Que YHWH haga brillar su rostro hacia ti y te conceda su favor.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Numbers 6:24–26 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/numbers-6-24-26/#v25

hebrew: יִשָּׂ֨א יְהוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
ko: 여호와께서 그분의 얼굴을 네게로 드시고 네게 평안을 주시기를.
en: May YHWH lift his face toward you and give you peace.
es: Que YHWH alce su rostro hacia ti y te dé paz.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Numbers 6:24–26 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/numbers-6-24-26/#v26

hebrew: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
ko: 지극히 높으신 이께서 민족들에게 기업을 나누어 주실 때, 인류를 갈라놓으실 때, 백성들의 경계를 하나님의 아들들의 수에 따라 정하셨다.
en: When the Most High apportioned inheritances to the nations, when he divided humankind, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
es: Cuando el Altísimo repartió herencias a las naciones, cuando separó a la humanidad, fijó los límites de los pueblos conforme al número de los hijos de Dios.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Deuteronomy 32:8 (ko), research pilot v0.4.36. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/deuteronomy-32-8/#v8
